name: Asia Capital Limited
about: Asia Capital Limited operates as a non-deposit taking non-banking financial company in India. It provides secured and unsecured loans and advances; loans against shares; structured term financing solutions to corporates; and loans to small and medium enterprises, as well as invests in securities, as well as invests in land, buildings, industries house, flats, commercial, agricultural, and mining properties. The company was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Mumbai, India. Asia Capital Limited is a subsidiary of SKC Investment Advisors Private Limited.
